title: The Visual Quran Atlas (Student Edition 03)
desc: Volume I: Surah Al-Fatihah, Surah Al-Baqarah & Bonus Ayat al-Kursi. High-definition vector edition.

title: Why This Atlas Exists & The 4 Editorial Labels
desc: Explaining the student companion philosophy and the 4 visual distinctions: [QURAN], [HADITH], [TAFSIR], [REFLECTION].

title: Table of Contents & 26-Plate Architecture Matrix
desc: Full architectural road-map: 14 thematic plates, 3 visual relationship maps, source registries, and glossary.

title: The Celestial Prologue & Absolute Praise (1:1–2)
desc: Pillars 1 & 2: Divine self-introduction, universal Rabb, and the ontological foundations of Hamd.

title: Oceans of Mercy & Sovereign Accountability (1:3–4)
desc: Pillars 3 & 4: The pairing of Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim balanced against the sovereign authority of Yawm ad-Din.

title: The Master Covenant & Highway of Guidance (1:5–6)
desc: Pillars 5 & 6: The exclusive covenant of worship (Iyyaka Na'bud) and the universal plea for Sirat al-Mustaqim.

title: The Three Human Destinies & Ring Transition (1:7)
desc: Pillars 7 & 8: Historical models of guidance, passive adab of wrath, and the architectural ring seed of the Quran.

title: Visual Relationship Map: Al-Fatihah & Bridge to Al-Baqarah
desc: Complete relational mindmap mapping the concentric ring structure of Al-Fatihah directly into Al-Baqarah.

title: Surah 01 Source Registry: Classical Tafsir, Hadith & Lexicology
desc: Primary scholarly provenance across Ibn Kathir, Al-Tabari, Al-Qurtubi, Al-Razi, As-Sa'di, and Sahih hadith.

title: Epistemology of Revelation & Five Marks of Taqwa (2:1–20)
desc: Pillars 1 & 2: Divine certainty of the Book, unseen belief, and the internal psychology of pious orientation.

title: Sealed Faculties & The Psychology of Hypocrisy (2:6–20)
desc: Pillars 3 & 4: Comparative study of overt rejection vs covert hypocrisy, dual parables of fire and rainstorm.

title: Universal Call, Adam's Caliphate & Primordial Drama (2:21–39)
desc: Pillars 5 & 6: The first universal call to humanity, angelic dialogue, Adam taught all names, and repentance.

title: Banu Isra'il, The Covenant of the Heifer & Hard Hearts (2:40–123)
desc: Pillars 7 & 8: Historical covenant accountability, the parable of the yellow cow, and the metaphor of tumbling stones.

title: The Abrahamic Standard & Sacred Qiblah Pivot (2:124–177)
desc: Pillars 9 & 10: Building the Ka'bah, the prophetic prayer for Mecca, the shift of spiritual axis, and Birr (righteousness).

title: The Medina Constitution & Community Architecture (2:178–242)
desc: Pillars 11 & 12: Sacred calendar, Ramadan fasting, defensive war ethics, and the jurisprudence of family equity.

title: Dedications: Ayat al-Kursi & The Triad of Proofs (2:243–260)
desc: Pillars 13 & 14: Kingship, struggle, Talut & Jalut, the Throne Verse, and empirical proofs of resurrection.

title: The Ethical Economy & The Believers' Supplication (2:261–286)
desc: Pillars 15 & 16: Sacred spending (Infaq), eliminating usury (Riba), commercial contracts, and closing Amanar-Rasul.

title: Visual Relationship Map: Surah Al-Baqarah Architecture
desc: Macrostructural architectural diagram mapping the 16 thematic pillars and structural symmetry of the 286 verses.

title: Surah 02 Source Registry: Classical Tafsir & Hadith
desc: Attribution matrix linking each thematic section to classical scholarly commentary and verified hadith.

title: Surah 02 Arabic Root Lexicology & Thematic Munasabah Map
desc: Key Arabic root words (Mufradat) and structural transitions linking Surah Al-Baqarah forward into Ali 'Imran.

title: The 10 Clauses & Concentric Ring Structure (Ayat al-Kursi, 2:255)
desc: The supreme Throne Verse: Ontological foundations, boundless knowledge, absolute sovereignty, and symmetric chiasmus.

title: Canonical Virtues & Daily Spiritual Shielding (Ayat al-Kursi)
desc: Ayat al-Kursi in the Prophetic Sunnah: Virtues from the Kutub al-Sittah, morning/evening protection, and after prayers.

title: Visual Relationship Map: Ayat al-Kursi Clause Study
desc: Proposed clause-by-clause visual study aid offered for contemplation, reflection, and deep memorization.

title: Scholarly Heritage: Classical Sunni Exegetes Cited
desc: Biographical overviews of Imam Al-Biqa'i, Ibn Kathir, Al-Tabari, Al-Qurtubi, Fakhr al-Din al-Razi, and As-Sa'di.

title: Study Aid: Key Quranic Terms & Plain-English Glossary
desc: Definitions of key theological and structural terms: Munasabah, Nazm, Taqwa, Infaq, Riba, Rabb, Sirat, and more.

title: Reader & Teacher Feedback Form
desc: Invitation for readers, teachers, and scholars to submit corrections, reflections, and insights for future editions.
